# tenferro v0.6.0

v0.6.0 completes full-matrices SVD across the CPU BLAS/LAPACK provider and the
CUDA backend, adds cuSOLVER driver selection for SVD and eigensolvers, opens the
scalar contract to externally defined scalars, and splits CPU kernel
compilation into two new published crates.

## Migration

- Update `tenferro-*` dependency requirements from `0.5` to `0.6` together.
- Backend implementors must provide the `TensorElementwise::elementwise_read_into`
  hook; it is now required rather than defaulted. The in-tree CPU and CUDA
  backends implement it, and the WebGPU backend reports an explicit unsupported
  error instead of falling back silently. ([#1791](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1791))
- `DType` is now the re-exported `tenferro_tensor_core::DType` and carries an
  `External(TypeId)` variant; `Tensor` gains a matching `External` variant and is
  a re-export of the generated default scalar set. Exhaustive matches over
  `DType` or `Tensor` need an arm for the external variants. Preset tags,
  variant names, and glob imports keep working unchanged. ([#1800](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1800))
- `tenferro-cpu-basic` and `tenferro-cpu-fused` are published for the first time
  in this release. `tenferro-cpu` keeps its existing public re-exports of the
  buffer pool, pooled outputs, and CPU runtime surface, so dependents that use
  `tenferro-cpu` need no source change.

## Features

- Full-matrices SVD: public borrowed and concrete entry points, CPU
  BLAS/LAPACK provider execution, and CUDA device-resident execution for
  F32/F64/C32/C64 with trailing batches. ([#1825](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1825), [#1826](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1826), [#1827](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1827))
- cuSOLVER driver selection: `SvdOptions::driver` and `EighOptions::driver`
  choose the cuSOLVER routine for CUDA SVD and eigensolvers.
  ([#1845](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1845), [#1850](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1850))
- Full-Q width for compact Householder `q_columns`, and borrowed-input parity
  for the remaining CPU read hooks. ([#1830](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1830), [#1829](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1829))
- Open scalar contract: `Scalar`, `ScalarArithmetic`, `ScalarDomain`,
  `ScalarSet`, and `define_scalar_set!` let a downstream crate declare and
  execute its own scalar, with `DType::External`/`Tensor::External` carrying a
  caller-owned payload and a derived (not hand-written) promotion lattice.
  ([#1800](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1800))
- `CpuBackend::with_execution_scope` shares one immutable CPU execution scope
  across ordinary eager, eager AD, and prepared trace calls.
  ([#1802](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1802))
- Prepared elementwise regions plan and execute through the scheduled
  production executor. ([#1811](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1811))
- CPU kernel compilation is split into `tenferro-cpu-basic` (shared host buffer
  pool, output guard, strided adapters) and `tenferro-cpu-fused` (runtime-DAG
  fused elementwise replay); `tenferro-cpu` assembles both.
  ([#1791](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1791))

## Fixes and execution improvements

- Elementwise fusion dtype precondition, complex `eigh` eigenvalue projection,
  and placement round-trip defects. ([#1843](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1843))
- CPU workers reserve a provider-safe stack and stay confined to the domain CPU
  set. ([#1844](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1844), [#1847](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1847))
- Determinant numerics and CUDA synchronization are stabilized; CUDA `_read`
  entry points accept borrowed views; eager and AD BLAS session operations share
  the executor context. ([#1799](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1799), [#1795](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1795), [#1796](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1796))
- Performance: LAPACK scratch comes from the session buffer pool, the eigenvalue
  cotangent and eager AD residuals are reused, batched solve and QR preparation
  are amortized, CUDA `dot-general` reads and fused broadcast multiply avoid
  materialized views, and FFT and eager CPU paths copy less.
  ([#1831](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1831), [#1835](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1835), [#1828](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1828), [#1821](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1821), [#1808](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1808), [#1797](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1797), [#1807](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1807), [#1786](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1786))
- The t4a CubeCL `0.10.1` and cubek `0.2.1` published releases and the merged
  strided-rs revision are pinned. ([#1837](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1837), [#1792](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1792))

## Documentation

- Lightweight work logs stay focused on decisions.
  ([#1794](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1794))
- Released-package dependency pins in the README, getting-started guide, and FFT
  guide name `0.6`.
